## Option B
## one simulation
```{r}
library(MCMCpack)
library(fastTopics)
library(limma)
library(clue)
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)

set.seed(1)

# ============================================================
# 1. Settings
# ============================================================
N <- 1000
G <- 500
K <- 6
n_diff <- 2
beta_strength <- 2
eps <- 1e-8

# ============================================================
# 2. Condition
# ============================================================
X <- rbinom(N, 1, 0.5)
cat("Number in control:", sum(X == 0), "\n")
cat("Number in treatment:", sum(X == 1), "\n")

# ============================================================
# 3. True topic-level parameters
# ============================================================
mu_k <- rnorm(K, 0, 0.5)

diff_k <- rep(FALSE, K)
diff_idx <- sample(1:K, n_diff, replace = FALSE)
diff_k[diff_idx] <- TRUE

# use same effect for all true topics to match current truth setup
beta_k <- ifelse(diff_k, beta_strength, 0)

truth_topic <- data.frame(
  topic = paste0("Topic", 1:K),
  mu_k = round(mu_k, 3),
  beta_k = round(beta_k, 3),
  diff_k = diff_k
)

cat("\n=== True topic-level truth ===\n")
print(truth_topic, row.names = FALSE)

# ============================================================
# 4. Generate latent logits and intensities
# ============================================================
eta <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = N, ncol = K)
for (k in 1:K) {
  eta[, k] <- rnorm(N, mean = mu_k[k] + X * beta_k[k], sd = 1)
}
colnames(eta) <- paste0("Topic", 1:K)

# Option 2 uses intensities, not softmax proportions
E_true <- exp(eta)
colnames(E_true) <- paste0("Topic", 1:K)

# also keep compositional truth for reference only
softmax <- function(v) exp(v) / sum(exp(v))
Z_true <- t(apply(eta, 1, softmax))
colnames(Z_true) <- paste0("Topic", 1:K)

cat("\nCheck rows of Z_true sum to 1:\n")
print(summary(rowSums(Z_true)))

# ============================================================
# 5. True topic-gene matrix and counts
# ============================================================
T_mat <- matrix(rlnorm(K * G, meanlog = 0, sdlog = 1), K, G)
W_true <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = K, ncol = G)
for (k in 1:K) {
  W_true[k, ] <- rdirichlet(1, alpha = T_mat[k, ])
}
rownames(W_true) <- paste0("Topic", 1:K)

library_size <- runif(N, 1000, 10000)

mean_ng <- (E_true %*% W_true) * library_size
Y_ng <- matrix(rpois(N * G, lambda = as.vector(mean_ng)), N, G)

cat("\nCounts matrix dimension:\n")
print(dim(Y_ng))
cat("Row sums of counts (should track library size):\n")
print(summary(rowSums(Y_ng)))

# ============================================================
# 6. Fit fastTopics
# ============================================================
fit <- fit_poisson_nmf(Y_ng, k = K, numiter = 200, verbose = "none")
fit_multinom <- poisson2multinom(fit)

theta_hat <- fit_multinom$L   # N x K estimated topic proportions
beta_hat  <- fit_multinom$F   # G x K estimated topic-gene weights

# ============================================================
# 7. Align estimated topics to truth
# ============================================================
compute_distance_matrix <- function(W_true, W_est) {
  K <- nrow(W_true)
  D <- matrix(NA_real_, K, K)
  for (k in 1:K) {
    for (j in 1:K) {
      v1 <- W_true[k, ]
      v2 <- W_est[j, ]
      cos_sim <- sum(v1 * v2) / (sqrt(sum(v1^2) * sum(v2^2)) + 1e-20)
      D[k, j] <- 1 - cos_sim
    }
  }
  D
}

compute_topic_error <- function(W_true, W_est) {
  diffs <- sqrt(rowSums((W_true - W_est)^2))
  list(
    per_topic = diffs,
    mean_error = mean(diffs),
    max_error = max(diffs)
  )
}

D <- compute_distance_matrix(W_true, t(beta_hat))
assignment <- solve_LSAP(D)

theta_hat_aligned <- theta_hat[, assignment, drop = FALSE]
beta_hat_aligned  <- beta_hat[, assignment, drop = FALSE]
W_est_aligned     <- t(beta_hat_aligned)

colnames(theta_hat_aligned) <- paste0("Topic", 1:K)
rownames(W_est_aligned) <- paste0("Topic", 1:K)

err <- compute_topic_error(W_true, W_est_aligned)

cat("\n=== Topic alignment ===\n")
print(data.frame(
  true_topic = paste0("Topic", 1:K),
  matched_estimated_topic = paste0("EstTopic", as.integer(assignment)),
  topic_error = round(err$per_topic, 4)
), row.names = FALSE)

cat("\nMean topic estimation error:", round(err$mean_error, 4), "\n")
cat("Max topic estimation error:", round(err$max_error, 4), "\n")

# ============================================================
# 8. Compare true vs estimated topic summaries
# ============================================================
mean_Ztrue_0 <- colMeans(Z_true[X == 0, , drop = FALSE])
mean_Ztrue_1 <- colMeans(Z_true[X == 1, , drop = FALSE])

mean_That_0 <- colMeans(theta_hat_aligned[X == 0, , drop = FALSE])
mean_That_1 <- colMeans(theta_hat_aligned[X == 1, , drop = FALSE])

topic_compare <- data.frame(
  topic = paste0("Topic", 1:K),
  diff_k = diff_k,
  beta_k = beta_k,
  true_mean_control = round(mean_Ztrue_0, 4),
  true_mean_treat   = round(mean_Ztrue_1, 4),
  true_diff         = round(mean_Ztrue_1 - mean_Ztrue_0, 4),
  est_mean_control  = round(mean_That_0, 4),
  est_mean_treat    = round(mean_That_1, 4),
  est_diff          = round(mean_That_1 - mean_That_0, 4)
)

cat("\n=== True vs estimated topic summaries ===\n")
print(topic_compare, row.names = FALSE)

# ============================================================
# 9. Plot estimated topic proportions by condition
# ============================================================
df_est_topic <- data.frame(
  sample = 1:N,
  condition = factor(X, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Control", "Treatment")),
  theta_hat_aligned
)

df_est_topic_long <- melt(
  df_est_topic,
  id.vars = c("sample", "condition"),
  variable.name = "topic",
  value.name = "theta_est"
)

ggplot(df_est_topic_long, aes(x = condition, y = theta_est, fill = condition)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.size = 0.4) +
  facet_wrap(~ topic, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "Estimated topic proportions by condition (aligned)",
    y = expression(hat(theta))
  )

# ============================================================
# 10. Pairwise truth and observed shifts
# ============================================================
pair_mat <- t(combn(K, 2))

pair_df <- data.frame(
  pair = apply(pair_mat, 1, function(idx) paste0("T", idx[1], "_vs_T", idx[2])),
  k1 = pair_mat[, 1],
  k2 = pair_mat[, 2]
)

# current truth setup: one true and one false = non-null
pair_df$diff_k1 <- diff_k[pair_df$k1]
pair_df$diff_k2 <- diff_k[pair_df$k2]
pair_df$pair_true <- pair_df$diff_k1 != pair_df$diff_k2

pair_df$beta_k1 <- beta_k[pair_df$k1]
pair_df$beta_k2 <- beta_k[pair_df$k2]
pair_df$beta_diff <- pair_df$beta_k1 - pair_df$beta_k2

# observed shift from true compositional proportions (reference only)
pair_df$obs_shift_true <- sapply(seq_len(nrow(pair_df)), function(i) {
  k1 <- pair_df$k1[i]
  k2 <- pair_df$k2[i]
  lr <- log(Z_true[, k1] + eps) - log(Z_true[, k2] + eps)
  mean(lr[X == 1]) - mean(lr[X == 0])
})

# observed shift from estimated aligned topic proportions
pair_df$obs_shift_est <- sapply(seq_len(nrow(pair_df)), function(i) {
  k1 <- pair_df$k1[i]
  k2 <- pair_df$k2[i]
  lr <- log(theta_hat_aligned[, k1] + eps) - log(theta_hat_aligned[, k2] + eps)
  mean(lr[X == 1]) - mean(lr[X == 0])
})

pair_df$obs_shift_true <- round(pair_df$obs_shift_true, 3)
pair_df$obs_shift_est  <- round(pair_df$obs_shift_est, 3)

cat("\n=== Pairwise truth table ===\n")
print(
  pair_df[, c("pair", "diff_k1", "diff_k2", "pair_true",
              "beta_diff", "obs_shift_true", "obs_shift_est")],
  row.names = FALSE
)

# ============================================================
# 11. Plot true vs estimated pairwise shifts
# ============================================================
ggplot(pair_df, aes(x = obs_shift_true, y = obs_shift_est, color = pair_true, label = pair)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text(nudge_y = 0.08, size = 3) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "True vs estimated pairwise log-ratio shifts",
    x = "Observed shift from true topic proportions",
    y = "Observed shift from estimated aligned topic proportions"
  )

# ============================================================
# 12. One-run ordinary + limma on estimated pairwise log-ratios
# ============================================================
n_pairs <- nrow(pair_mat)

log_ratio_mat_est <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = N, ncol = n_pairs)
colnames(log_ratio_mat_est) <- pair_df$pair

for (p in 1:n_pairs) {
  k1 <- pair_mat[p, 1]
  k2 <- pair_mat[p, 2]
  log_ratio_mat_est[, p] <- log(theta_hat_aligned[, k1] + eps) -
                            log(theta_hat_aligned[, k2] + eps)
}

design <- model.matrix(~ X)
fit0 <- lmFit(t(log_ratio_mat_est), design)

coef_hat <- fit0$coefficients[, 2]
se_hat   <- fit0$stdev.unscaled[, 2] * fit0$sigma

# ordinary
t_ord <- coef_hat / se_hat
p_ord <- 2 * pt(-abs(t_ord), df = fit0$df.residual)
q_ord <- p.adjust(p_ord, method = "BH")
disc_ord <- q_ord < 0.05

# limma
fit_eb <- eBayes(fit0)
q_limma <- p.adjust(fit_eb$p.value[, 2], method = "BH")
disc_limma <- q_limma < 0.05

one_run_res <- data.frame(
  pair = pair_df$pair,
  pair_true = pair_df$pair_true,
  beta_diff = pair_df$beta_diff,
  obs_shift_true = pair_df$obs_shift_true,
  obs_shift_est  = pair_df$obs_shift_est,
  coef_hat = round(coef_hat, 3),
  se_hat = round(se_hat, 3),
  q_ord = signif(q_ord, 3),
  disc_ord = disc_ord,
  q_limma = signif(q_limma, 3),
  disc_limma = disc_limma
)

cat("\n=== One-run testing results on estimated topic proportions ===\n")
print(one_run_res, row.names = FALSE)

# ============================================================
# 13. One pair in detail
# ============================================================
k1 <- pair_mat[1, 1]
k2 <- pair_mat[1, 2]
pair_name <- paste0("T", k1, "_vs_T", k2)

lr_true <- log(Z_true[, k1] + eps) - log(Z_true[, k2] + eps)
lr_est  <- log(theta_hat_aligned[, k1] + eps) - log(theta_hat_aligned[, k2] + eps)

df_pair_detail <- data.frame(
  condition = factor(X, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Control", "Treatment")),
  log_ratio_true = lr_true,
  log_ratio_est  = lr_est
)

cat("\n=== Detailed check for", pair_name, "===\n")
cat("diff_k1 =", diff_k[k1], "\n")
cat("diff_k2 =", diff_k[k2], "\n")
cat("pair_true =", diff_k[k1] != diff_k[k2], "\n")
cat("beta_1 =", beta_k[k1], "\n")
cat("beta_2 =", beta_k[k2], "\n")
cat("mean TRUE log-ratio in control =", round(mean(lr_true[X == 0]), 3), "\n")
cat("mean TRUE log-ratio in treatment =", round(mean(lr_true[X == 1]), 3), "\n")
cat("mean EST log-ratio in control =", round(mean(lr_est[X == 0]), 3), "\n")
cat("mean EST log-ratio in treatment =", round(mean(lr_est[X == 1]), 3), "\n")

df_pair_detail_long <- melt(
  df_pair_detail,
  id.vars = "condition",
  variable.name = "source",
  value.name = "log_ratio"
)

ggplot(df_pair_detail_long, aes(x = condition, y = log_ratio, fill = condition)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ source, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = paste0(pair_name, ": true vs estimated log-ratio by condition"),
    y = "Log-ratio"
  )
```

## all simulation
```{r}
library(MCMCpack)
library(fastTopics)
library(limma)
library(clue)
library(JuliaCall)

# ============================================================
# Julia setup for EPB
# ============================================================
julia_setup(JULIA_HOME = "/opt/anaconda3/julia_env/pyjuliapkg/install/bin")
julia_command("import Pkg")
julia_command('Pkg.activate("/opt/anaconda3/julia_env")')
julia_command("using Empirikos, Hypatia, MultipleTesting")

run_epb_pairs <- function(beta_hat, se_hat, df_resid, alpha = 0.05) {
  beta_vec <- as.numeric(beta_hat)
  se2_vec  <- as.numeric(se_hat^2)
  nu_val   <- as.integer(df_resid[1])

  julia_assign("beta_vec_r", beta_vec)
  julia_assign("se2_vec_r", se2_vec)
  julia_assign("nu_val_r", nu_val)
  julia_assign("alpha_r", alpha)

  julia_command("
    samples_epb = [Empirikos.NormalChiSquareSample(beta_vec_r[i], se2_vec_r[i], nu_val_r)
                   for i in eachindex(beta_vec_r)]
  ")
  julia_command("
    test_epb_r = Empirikos.EmpiricalPartiallyBayesTTest(
      α = alpha_r,
      solver = Hypatia.Optimizer
    )
  ")
  julia_command("res_epb_r = fit(test_epb_r, samples_epb)")

  list(
    adjp   = as.numeric(julia_eval('res_epb_r.adjp')),
    rj_idx = as.logical(julia_eval('res_epb_r.rj_idx'))
  )
}

# ============================================================
# helpers
# ============================================================
compute_distance_matrix <- function(W_true, W_est) {
  K <- nrow(W_true)
  D <- matrix(NA_real_, K, K)
  for (k in 1:K) {
    for (j in 1:K) {
      v1 <- W_true[k, ]
      v2 <- W_est[j, ]
      cos_sim <- sum(v1 * v2) / (sqrt(sum(v1^2) * sum(v2^2)) + 1e-20)
      D[k, j] <- 1 - cos_sim
    }
  }
  D
}

compute_topic_error <- function(W_true, W_est) {
  diffs <- sqrt(rowSums((W_true - W_est)^2))
  list(
    per_topic = diffs,
    mean_error = mean(diffs),
    max_error = max(diffs)
  )
}

get_metrics <- function(disc, truth) {
  power <- mean(disc[truth])
  n_disc <- sum(disc)
  fdr <- if (n_disc == 0) 0 else sum(disc & !truth) / n_disc
  c(power = power, fdr = fdr, n_disc = n_disc)
}

# ============================================================
# one Option 2 simulation run
# ============================================================
run_one_option2 <- function(seed,
                            N = 1000,
                            G = 500,
                            K = 6,
                            n_diff = 2,
                            beta_strength = 2,
                            eps = 1e-8) {
  set.seed(seed)

  # 1. condition
  X <- rbinom(N, 1, 0.5)

  # 2. true topic effects
  mu_k <- rnorm(K, 0, 0.5)

  diff_k <- rep(FALSE, K)
  diff_idx <- sample(1:K, n_diff, replace = FALSE)
  diff_k[diff_idx] <- TRUE

  beta_k <- ifelse(diff_k, beta_strength, 0)

  # 3. latent logits and intensities
  eta <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = N, ncol = K)
  for (k in 1:K) {
    eta[, k] <- rnorm(N, mean = mu_k[k] + X * beta_k[k], sd = 1)
  }
  E_true <- exp(eta)

  # 4. true topic-gene matrix
  T_mat <- matrix(rlnorm(K * G, meanlog = 0, sdlog = 1), K, G)
  W_true <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = K, ncol = G)
  for (k in 1:K) {
    W_true[k, ] <- rdirichlet(1, alpha = T_mat[k, ])
  }

  # 5. counts
  library_size <- runif(N, 1000, 10000)
  mean_ng <- (E_true %*% W_true) * library_size
  Y_ng <- matrix(rpois(N * G, lambda = as.vector(mean_ng)), N, G)

  # 6. fit fastTopics
  fit <- fit_poisson_nmf(Y_ng, k = K, numiter = 200, verbose = "none")
  fit_multinom <- poisson2multinom(fit)

  theta_hat <- fit_multinom$L
  beta_hat  <- fit_multinom$F

  # 7. align topics
  D <- compute_distance_matrix(W_true, t(beta_hat))
  assignment <- solve_LSAP(D)

  theta_hat_aligned <- theta_hat[, assignment, drop = FALSE]
  beta_hat_aligned  <- beta_hat[, assignment, drop = FALSE]
  W_est_aligned     <- t(beta_hat_aligned)

  err <- compute_topic_error(W_true, W_est_aligned)

  # 8. pairwise truth
  pair_mat <- t(combn(K, 2))
  n_pairs <- nrow(pair_mat)

  pair_true <- apply(pair_mat, 1, function(idx) {
    diff_k[idx[1]] != diff_k[idx[2]]
  })

  # 9. estimated pairwise log-ratios
  log_ratio_mat_est <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = N, ncol = n_pairs)
  colnames(log_ratio_mat_est) <- apply(pair_mat, 1, function(idx) {
    paste0("T", idx[1], "_vs_T", idx[2])
  })

  for (p in 1:n_pairs) {
    k1 <- pair_mat[p, 1]
    k2 <- pair_mat[p, 2]
    log_ratio_mat_est[, p] <- log(theta_hat_aligned[, k1] + eps) -
                              log(theta_hat_aligned[, k2] + eps)
  }

  # 10. ordinary + limma
  design <- model.matrix(~ X)
  fit0 <- lmFit(t(log_ratio_mat_est), design)

  coef_hat <- fit0$coefficients[, 2]
  se_hat   <- fit0$stdev.unscaled[, 2] * fit0$sigma

  # ordinary
  t_ord <- coef_hat / se_hat
  p_ord <- 2 * pt(-abs(t_ord), df = fit0$df.residual)
  q_ord <- p.adjust(p_ord, method = "BH")
  disc_ord <- q_ord < 0.05

  # limma
  fit_eb <- eBayes(fit0)
  q_limma <- p.adjust(fit_eb$p.value[, 2], method = "BH")
  disc_limma <- q_limma < 0.05

  # EPB
  epb_res <- run_epb_pairs(
    beta_hat = coef_hat,
    se_hat   = se_hat,
    df_resid = fit0$df.residual,
    alpha    = 0.05
  )
  disc_epb <- epb_res$rj_idx

  list(
    truth = list(diff_k = diff_k, beta_k = beta_k, pair_true = pair_true),
    topic_error = err,
    ordinary = get_metrics(disc_ord, pair_true),
    limma    = get_metrics(disc_limma, pair_true),
    epb      = get_metrics(disc_epb, pair_true)
  )
}
```

```{r}
R <- 50

res_list <- lapply(1:R, function(r) run_one_option2(seed = r))

summary_df <- data.frame(
  sim = 1:R,

  power_ord = sapply(res_list, function(x) x$ordinary["power"]),
  fdr_ord   = sapply(res_list, function(x) x$ordinary["fdr"]),
  ndisc_ord = sapply(res_list, function(x) x$ordinary["n_disc"]),

  power_limma = sapply(res_list, function(x) x$limma["power"]),
  fdr_limma   = sapply(res_list, function(x) x$limma["fdr"]),
  ndisc_limma = sapply(res_list, function(x) x$limma["n_disc"]),

  power_epb = sapply(res_list, function(x) x$epb["power"]),
  fdr_epb   = sapply(res_list, function(x) x$epb["fdr"]),
  ndisc_epb = sapply(res_list, function(x) x$epb["n_disc"]),

  mean_topic_err = sapply(res_list, function(x) x$topic_error$mean_error),
  max_topic_err  = sapply(res_list, function(x) x$topic_error$max_error)
)

summary_df
```
